notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
If Voltaic Construct is on the battlefield, activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder. Otherwise, activate Myr Welder using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
